title: Engine Settings & Verification
desc: Per-engine configuration and the verification/self-test flow.
lede: Each engine carries its own settings and a self-test, so you can configure it and confirm it actually works before relying on it.
body:
At a glance
  • Settings are schema-driven — the form comes from the engine.
  • Verify runs a real test synthesis.
  • Engines report a clear status.

Schema-driven engine settings

Each engine declares its own settings. Studio renders the form from that schema, so an engine's options (models, keys, tuning) appear without hard-coding anything in the UI.

Verification & test runs

Verify runs a quick synthesis to prove the engine is working. Use it after setup or after changing a setting, and read the diagnostics if it fails.

Enable / disable & status

Engines show a clear status — ready, needs setup, or unavailable — so you know what will happen before you queue a job. Manage all of this in Settings.
